info.name: AWS EC2 Instance Metadata SSRF Leak
author: pdteam
info.description: Server-Side Request Forgery allows accessing AWS IMDSv1 internal endpoint at http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/
info.remediation: Enforce IMDSv2 and restrict outbound HTTP requests to internal cloud metadata endpoints.

info.name: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
info.description: HTTP Strict Transport Security header is missing, allowing potential Man-in-the-Middle SSL stripping attacks.
info.remediation: Configure HTTP Strict-Transport-Security response header with max-age >= 31536000 and includeSubDomains.
